setups.label: 20-day breakout
setups.rule: Last close above every close of the 20 sessions before it.

setups.label: Bull flag
setups.rule: Up more than 10% over 10 sessions, then the last 5 closes inside a 5% range.

setups.label: Reclaimed 20-day avg
setups.rule: Previous close under its 20-day average, last close above it.

setups.label: Oversold bounce
setups.rule: RSI 14 was under 30 the session before, and the last close was up.
